players.name: LaMelo Ball
players.comment: Ball (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies. The guard was previously questionable after spraining his left ankle during Wednesday's win over Oklahoma City.

players.name: Cameron Boozer
players.comment: Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Zach Edey
players.comment: Edey (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the Timberwolves.
